intro: Barnil Stonepot is trying to restore the opening portion of Hemet Nesingwary's scattered hunting manuscript, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn. He needs four missing leaves gathered from across the jungle to bind the introductory section back together.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Chapter I was quite riveting! Master Nesingwary sets the backdrop for the story and makes mention of his hunting companions, including me!
But that's besides the point. Let me see which pages are still missing. It seems pages 1, 4, 6 and 8 are still out there somewhere in the jungle!

clips.title: Progress
paras: I don't suppose you were able to track down pages 1, 4, 6 and 8? Those four are all we need to piece Chapter I back together.

clips.title: Completion
paras: At last! Chapter I is complete!
